summary_1line: Sanjaya describes northern mythic islands, oceans of unusual substances, sacred mountains, divine beings, and cosmic elephants controlling winds and sustaining life.

image_candidates.scene_text: Four colossal celestial elephants stand at the corners of a star-shaped realm, drawing in roaring winds with their lotus-colored trunks.
A radiant golden mountain in Kusadwipa rises amid coral-studded slopes while the god Narayana dwells upon it among liberated beings.
Vast mythic oceans of clarified butter, curds, and wine encircle distant northern islands under a luminous sky.
